title: Length of a Repayment Plan by Size of the Open Receivable — Network Participation Agreements
content:
Repayment plans under the **Network Participation Agreements** run longer for larger balances.

**Schedule.** The base plan run count is set by the size of the agreement's open receivable:

| Open receivable | Base plan run count |
|---|---|
| 5000 USD or more | 26 runs |
| 1000 USD or more but less than 5000 USD | 18 runs |
| Less than 1000 USD | Not lengthened by this schedule |

## Which amount is measured

The open receivable is the total of the agreement's overpayment notices, less every withholding, refund and reduction booked against them, the plan down payment included.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- 999.99 USD: not lengthened.
- 1000.00 USD: 18 runs.
- 4999.99 USD: 18 runs.
- 5000.00 USD: 26 runs.
